data_description.scan_interval: How often the feed is fetched. Default is 60 minutes.

data_description.feed_url: The new address of the same feed. The sensor keeps its entity ID and its history, so cards and automations that use it keep working.

error.invalid_feed: This URL is reachable, but it does not serve an RSS or Atom feed.
error.already_configured: Another feed is already configured for this URL.

abort.unknown_entry: This feed is no longer configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the feed is fetched. Default is 60 minutes.
data_description.max_text_length: Long text such as the summary is shortened to this many characters. Default is 250, 0 keeps the full text.
data_description.inclusions: Only these fields are kept on each entry. Leave empty to keep every field the feed sends.
data_description.exclusions: These fields are dropped from each entry.
